headline: Financial Software Firm N5 Acquires Three AI Startups for $34 Million
summary: Fintech firm N5 invested $34 million to acquire three artificial intelligence companies: Dojo, Memo, and Boost. The acquisitions will integrate meeting analysis, workforce training, and commercial incentive management across its operating platform.
why: M&A activity in financial enterprise software highlights continuous tech consolidation and enterprise adoption of specialized AI tools.
